test_get_toolset: test the get_toolset function to retrieve a named toolset and verify its tools list
test_resolve_toolset: test the resolve_toolset function to expand a toolset name into its full deduplicated tool list
test_resolve_multiple_toolsets: test the resolve_multiple_toolsets function to combine and deduplicate multiple toolset names
test_validate_toolset: test the validate_toolset function to check whether a toolset name is valid
test_get_toolset_info: test the get_toolset_info function to retrieve metadata like composite status and tool count
test_create_custom_toolset: test the create_custom_toolset function to dynamically register a new toolset at runtime
test_get_all_toolsets: test the get_all_toolsets function to list all available built-in and plugin toolsets
test_toolset_cycle_detection: test that resolve_toolset detects and handles circular includes without infinite looping
test_toolset_alias_resolution: test that resolve_toolset resolves aliases like all, star, and plugin registry aliases
test_registry_owned_toolsets: test that toolsets registered in the ToolRegistry are live and discoverable
